name: software
about: Software development as agentic-kit's KIT.md runs it: a phase is planned, the plan reviewed, the code written and then critiqued.

roles.name: phase-planner
roles.about: Plans a phase from its briefs, policies and the root invariants.

roles.name: plan-reviewer
roles.about: Inspects a plan independently and reports advisory findings.

roles.name: phase-coder
roles.about: Implements the planned work and runs focused checks.

roles.name: code-critic
roles.about: Inspects the implementation against the approved plan and reports advisory findings.
